commands.command: TBD: replay or construct normal/reset/delayed/zero-action/wrong-history interventions on the M111 matched-current-response pair surface
commands.name: m112_matched_history_intervention_gate

decision_rule: Use M111 matched-current-response pairs as an outcome-relevant intervention surface; admit a checkpoint or objective only if wrong/reset/delayed histories cause measurable action or clearance degradation while normal retention remains intact.
failure_criteria: matched pairs only differ in target probes but do not change policy action or rollout outcome
reset or wrong history does not degrade action choice, clearance margin, or success on the matched surface
the intervention uses hidden parameters or oracle labels as deployable actor input
normal behavior retention regresses relative to M62-class baseline
hypothesis: M111 found current-response-matched future-envelope ambiguity, but current hidden states do not systematically encode it. A stronger gate should test whether normal history, reset history, delayed history, zero-action history, and wrong matched history produce different actions or rollout outcomes on that surface.
success_criteria: M111 matched pairs are reused or converted into replay snippets
normal/reset/delayed/zero-action/wrong-history variants are compared on action and outcome metrics
normal retention is checked against the current M62-class baseline
the result decides whether to train an intervention objective or redesign the task/simulator
